name: opsos
description: Operations OS — real-time operational command center for online brokerage operations.

scripts.dev: echo "Run 'npm run dev' inside apps/web and apps/api separately, or use two terminals."
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/web run build && npm --workspace apps/api run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/web run lint && npm --workspace apps/api run lint
scripts.db:migrate: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma db seed
